data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6112 opened the year with gross claims outstanding of GBP 43.903m and closed 2015 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 46.298m. During 2015 there was a small adverse prior-year run-off deviation of GBP 0.2m, recorded wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012 year of account under the Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003. The movement represents a slight strengthening of prior year reserves (c.0.46% of opening gross claims outstanding) and is attributed to adverse claims development and reinsurance-related reserve movements.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Technical provisions, Claims outstanding) 2014 comparative column. Prior year development taken from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (note 9) which explicitly states an adverse run-off deviation of GBP 0.2m wholly relating to the 2012 year of account under the Whole Account Quota Share with Syndicate 2003. The Technical Reserves reconciliation table shows gross movement in claims outstanding across the year (movement = GBP 0.994m) but that includes all current year movements; per instructions the explicit prior-year movement sentence (note 9) is the authoritative prior-year development figure. Segmental premium mix taken from the Segmental Analysis note. Claims development triangle is present (gross) and was used for cross-checking.
